identifierHints.sms: Short code or long code, e.g. 55119

integration.noConfigurationsHint: Create an integration to set up API credentials, then add your phone numbers or addresses as endpoints.
integration.credentialsNoFields: No credential fields for this channel.

endpoint.title: Endpoints
endpoint.webhookNote: Webhook endpoints need no provider account — just a URL slug and a target pool. Each endpoint can optionally require a token on every trigger; without one it accepts anonymous calls from anyone who can reach it.
endpoint.speechProfileMissingHint: This endpoint points to a speech profile that does not exist: calls use the tenant settings, and the gateway logs a warning.
endpoint.webrtcNote: WebRTC endpoints need no provider account — the media server is part of the deployment. Each endpoint is the address the call widget connects to (/ws/webrtc/{identifier}) and the pool it lands in; the pool can change behind a published address. An address with no endpoint is still read as a pool id.
endpoint.noEndpoints: No endpoints yet. Click "+ Add endpoint" to add a {{channel}} number or address.
endpoint.noEndpointsStandalone: No endpoints configured. Click "+ Add endpoint" to create one.

auth.anonymousHint: Anyone who can reach this address can trigger it — no credential is checked. Generate a token to require one.

token.rotateHint: Requires X-Webhook-Token on every trigger. The token is shown once and cannot be recovered.
token.revokeHint: Removes the token AND turns authentication off — the endpoint goes back to accepting anonymous triggers.
token.rotateConfirm: Rotating invalidates the current token immediately. Any integration still using it will start failing. Continue?
token.revokeConfirm: This removes the token AND turns authentication off — the endpoint will accept anonymous triggers from anyone who can reach it. Continue?
token.freshWarning: This is the only time this token is shown. It is not stored and cannot be recovered — if you lose it, you must rotate, which invalidates this one.
token.lockNotice: The other endpoint actions stay locked until you confirm — so this token can't be mistaken for another row's.
token.lockHint: Save the token for "{{identifier}}" and confirm first — it is shown only once.

originHint.external: Registered on this screen by your team.
originHint.internal: Declared in the environment provisioning and served by an internal pool. Read-only here.
originHint.legacy_token: Migrated from the legacy token-based webhook registry.

endpoint.readOnlyHint: This endpoint comes from the environment declaration, not from this screen. Editing it here would be undone on the next platform restart — change it at the source.
endpoint.poolAddressTitle: Implicit address of every webhook pool
endpoint.poolAddressNote: Besides the identifiers above, each webhook pool can also be triggered directly by its pool id. These addresses have no registry row because they already point at the pool itself — there is nothing a row could add.

form.speechProfileHint: Calls that enter through this address use this profile's speech settings (Settings tab). Without one, the tenant settings apply.
form.authRequired: Require a token on every trigger
form.authRequiredOnHint: The token is shown once, right after creating — it is never stored in clear and cannot be recovered, only rotated. Copy it before closing.
form.authRequiredOffHint: Anonymous endpoint: anyone who can reach the gateway will be able to trigger it. You can generate a token later from the list.

webrtcSpeech.title: Speech segmentation (voice bot)
webrtcSpeech.intro: How the customer's speech in a WebRTC call is cut into utterances before transcription. Saving writes a value for THIS tenant; the platform keeps the default.
webrtcSpeech.missing: not configured — the gateway uses its code default
webrtcSpeech.saved: Saved. It applies to the next call.
webrtcSpeech.restored: Tenant value removed; the platform default applies to the next call.
webrtcSpeech.invalid: {{key}}: value out of range ({{min}}–{{max}}) or wrong type.
webrtcSpeech.provenanceError: could not tell which scope applies ({{error}})
webrtcSpeech.noteNextCall: Values are read when a call opens transcription: calls in progress keep the values they started with.
webrtcSpeech.noteMenu: A menu that declares collect.voice.end_silence_ms or max_speech_s overrides silence and maximum speech while it waits for the answer.
webrtcSpeech.noteVad: Voice activity detection was measured with synthetic speech: without it every noise sample became text; with it, no speech was lost. Turn it off only with a measurement of your own callers.

stt_energy_threshold.label: Energy threshold
stt_energy_threshold.help: Frame loudness (RMS, 16-bit) counted as voice — also used for barge-in. Line noise above it is sent to transcription. 50–5000.

stt_gap_ms.label: No-audio gap (ms)
stt_gap_ms.help: Time with no audio frames at all that also closes an utterance (a muted microphone sends nothing). 100–5000.

stt_min_speech_ms.label: Minimum speech (ms)
stt_min_speech_ms.help: Voice shorter than this is a click or cough and is not transcribed. 50–2000.

stt_max_speech_ms.label: Maximum speech (ms)
stt_max_speech_ms.help: An utterance longer than this is cut and transcribed. 1000–60000.

stt_vad_filter.label: Voice activity detection
stt_vad_filter.help: The transcription service discards stretches with no speech instead of inventing text.

speechProfiles.title: Speech profiles
speechProfiles.intro: A profile adapts speech recognition to one kind of entry path — a browser, a SIP trunk, another language. Point a WebRTC endpoint to it. Empty fields inherit the tenant settings above (model, language and voice: the deployment default).
speechProfiles.inheritNote: Order at call time: menu → profile → tenant → platform default. The model must be one the speech service has; an unknown model makes every utterance fail, logged by the gateway.
speechProfiles.empty: No speech profile. Calls use the tenant settings.
speechProfiles.invalidId: Invalid profile id: lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 64), starting with a letter or digit.
speechProfiles.invalidField: {{key}}: value out of range or in the wrong format.
speechProfiles.saved: Profile {{id}} saved. It applies to the next call.
speechProfiles.deleteConfirmUsed: Profile {{id}} is used by {{count}} endpoint(s). Their calls will fall back to the tenant settings. Delete anyway?
